entries.title: A card no longer takes the caret back from the panel you click next
entries.body: For a few seconds after you clicked or typed in a card or an added panel, its script could pull the caret back. If you clicked straight into another panel, such as the Tasks search, your next keys landed back where you had been. Your caret and keys now stay in the panel you clicked.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new is drawn: the caret stays in the field you clicked, as it looked before the card's script ran.
